title: Remote Compute MU authoritative boundaries and integration gates

records.rule: Remote Compute MU manages external execution personalities. Neither Colab sessions nor ZeroGPU Spaces are full-time MI members; only real current MI capabilities are projected to placement as such.

The Job-to-Node Allocator v0.6 is the only placement/lease authority. WLU entitlement is separate. Before any external effect, verify exact current WLU rights, lease and ownership fence through their real upstream APIs.
Write SUBMITTING and a stable dispatchKey durably before any provider side effect. Unknown submit outcome MUST be reconciled with provider evidence; never retry blindly.
Write COMMITTING before an effectful output commit. Never repeat an ambiguous Storage Fabric commit. Provider success must not become job success until durable output verification and commit succeed.
A cancellation request is not a cancellation outcome. Never mark an uncertain remote submission cancelled merely because no remote identifier is known.
Reuse ooRexx Colab Job v0.3-dev1. Resource requirements are hard, actual worker capacity must be observed, secrets are references, and outputs need verified receipts and durable promotion.
Use the existing Hugging Face Space Job contract for supported Space operations. ZeroGPU is a shared execution API, not an owned exclusive GPU or checkpointable MI.
Run Windows-kernel containers only on compatible Windows hosts with pinned images; use a governed Windows VM for full OS and GUI testing. Linux Docker is not a Windows kernel.
Transport and status evidence never mint placement leases or settle work. Reuse the authenticated mesh and Connect Selector choices; do not build a mandatory new Queue Fabric dependency.

Dev2 is a tested Python durable reference controller plus ooRexx semantic frontage. Live provider, real Job-to-Node/WLU/Storage, mesh registration and HA ownership integrations remain unbound. Do not claim an operational commissioned MU.
Native MU ingress is a semantic receiver, NOT a transport. Its trusted identity context is supplied out of band by a verified carrier; DISPATCH, STATUS, CANCEL and RECOVER are governed operations.

All operations fail closed without current trusted context and external policy admission. The policy MUST verify current LDAP identity, MI incarnation/ownership epoch, service audience, replay freshness, operation scope and revocation. The raw payload has no authentication authority.
A semantic ooRexx reply is NOT a wire frame. Transport must use allowlisted output projection, not object dumps or secret-bearing serialization.
